scenes.title: A build contract
scenes.accessibleDescription: Turn an agreed design into behavior an agent can implement and test.

scenes.title: Make it concrete
scenes.accessibleDescription: A useful form requirement says what to accept, reject, and preserve.

scenes.title: Design acceptance
scenes.accessibleDescription: Connect each observable requirement to a check and evidence.

scenes.title: Preserve boundaries
scenes.accessibleDescription: Name existing behavior and external systems the change must protect.

scenes.title: Order the work
scenes.accessibleDescription: Workers need agreed interfaces and exclusive ownership to work safely.

scenes.title: Ready for kickoff?
scenes.accessibleDescription: A fresh agent needs a bounded plan, acceptance checks, and authority.

scenes.title: Name the outcome
scenes.accessibleDescription: Describe what the owner can actually do at the end of the workflow.

scenes.title: Inputs and errors
scenes.accessibleDescription: Specify how valid and invalid requests behave at the form boundary.

scenes.title: Proof you can trace
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use a stable requirement ID to link behavior, test, and result.

scenes.title: Compatibility and undo
scenes.accessibleDescription: A change contract should explain what stays intact and how to recover.

scenes.title: Dependency graph
scenes.accessibleDescription: Establish shared data before parallel components rely on it.

scenes.title: Walk three cases
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use examples to reveal gaps in the specification before implementation.

scenes.title: Fresh-agent check
scenes.accessibleDescription: Can a new reader find the contract, rationale, first task, and stop condition?
